climate_method.baseline: Observed hourly weather 2005-2024, median diurnal profile of the hottest 5% of summer days
climate_method.baseline_note: This is an observed hot-day baseline, not current weather. No live weather service is connected.
climate_method.projection_source: CMIP6-LOCA2 27-model county release, ssp370, paired per model against each model's own 1981-2010 run
climate_method.thermal_index: UTCI (Universal Thermal Climate Index), ECMWF thermofeel implementation
climate_method.mean_radiant_temperature: Computed from shortwave components; sun exposure scales the direct beam only
climate_method.longwave_assumption: Downward longwave estimated from screen-level temperature and humidity, Prata (1996)
climate_method.severe_threshold: UTCI >= 38.0 C is the published 'Very Strong Heat Stress' class - a thermal-stress category, not a diagnosis
climate_method.disclaimer: Stress-test values for comparing interventions, not forecasts for a calendar year, and not a medical prediction for any person.

canopy.source: Allegheny County Urban Tree Canopy 2010 (Tree Pittsburgh / Univ. of Vermont)
